items.description: He’s round. He’s hungry. He’s back! Help your feline friend eat all the sushi (and find love) in this bundle of squishy puzzle classics! This collection includes the original Sushi Cat, Sushi Cat The Honeymoon, Sushi Cat 2, The Great Purrade, Sushi Cat-a-Pult, and more...
items.title: Sushi Cat Legacy Collection

items.description: Chaos Faction and Chaos Faction 2, both in their original format, return in the Chaos Faction Legacy Collection . Experience the frantic action that helped define the earliest generation of brawlers. Master arenas, outmaneuver foes, unlock new characters, and relive the legacy of Chaos Faction.
items.title: Chaos Faction Legacy Collection

items.description: Survive the zombie apocalypse and make humanity's last stand in this three-game legacy bundle, revamped for modern hardware. Explore, build, and survive for as long as you can in The Last Stand, The Last Stand 2, and The Last Stand: Union City.
items.title: The Last Stand Legacy Collection

items.description: Crush the Castle Legacy Collection is the triumphant return of the classic Armor Games physics destruction game! Let destruction reign by loading up your trusty trebuchet and showing the enemy castle who’s boss.
items.title: Crush the Castle Legacy Collection

items.description: Step into the monochromatic and mind-bending universe of the Shift series developed by Antony Lavelle, where black and white landscapes hide more than meets the eye. This collection unites the original four titles - Shift, Shift 2, Shift 3, and Shift 4.
items.title: Shift: Legacy Collection

items.description: You can’t run from your dreams in this unsettling classic point-and-click horror game from award-winning indie developer scriptwelder. To find a way out, you’ll have to go even deeper into your nightmares.
items.title: Deep Sleep Trilogy

items.description: In this classic point-and-click adventure anthology by award-winning indie developer Scriptwelder, you'll protect an unsuspecting hamlet from yourself, try to prepare for an incoming undead horde, and search a seemingly empty spaceship for answers to a gruesome mystery.
items.title: Don't Escape Trilogy

items.description: All 5 classic games from SoulGame Studio in one epic collection. Slash through enemies and apples in Swords & Souls . Grab the wheel and outrun trouble in The Soul Driver. items.title: Swords & Souls Legacy

items.description: Warfare 1917 and 1944 return, fully remastered with enhanced visuals, full-screen support, and custom battles. Warfare Legacy Collection also Includes the Battle of the Bulge, a brand-new campaign set during WWII’s final offensive with all-new missions, snowy maps, and intense front-line action.
items.title: Warfare Legacy Collection

items.description: Say helloaphant to jmtb02’s classic series of elephant games–now remastered into one elephant-sized package!
items.title: The Elephant Collection

items.description: All the games in the classic Decision series bundled together. From the zombie-ravaged streets of the original Decision to the brutal medieval battlegrounds of Decision Medieval, this collection delivers the raw, blood-soaked combat, base building, and survival gameplay that hooked Flash game fans.
items.title: Decision Legacy Collection

items.description: Sonny 1 and Sonny 2 team up in the Sonny Legacy Collection . Traverse a story-rich world where strategy meets supernatural in a quest for identity and survival. Master tactical turn-based combat and discover the truth behind Sonny's resurrection in these classic RPGs.
items.title: Sonny Legacy Collection
